findings.description: After stripping leading dots, the code prepends a dot and uses endswith for suffix matching. Entries given as host:port (e.g. "example.com:8080") now only match subdomains such as "foo.example.com:8080"; this may be intended. A more significant issue is that IP/CIDR-like or non-dot-bounded entries change behavior. The previous code matched "notexample.com" against the entry "example.com"; the new code does not, which is the bpo-39057 intent.
findings.rationale: This mirrors the upstream CPython fix, so the behavior is likely intentional. Trigger: no_proxy="example.com" with URL host "notexample.com" is now not bypassed, which matches upstream. No concrete defect was found, so the finding is low confidence.
